relevance.why: Distribution for Haji's apps is a real need and the one-link-to-all-captions loop is time-cheap; but the 41.9M figure is a creator-economy outlier, and Blotato is another subscription.

implement_score.why: Worth a small experiment: a Claude Code skill that takes a video link and emits platform captions, piped to Postiz (open-source, already in liked set) or Blotato's API. Half a day to wire; value depends on how much Haji posts.

verify: Blotato pricing and whether it has an API/MCP that Claude Code can call directly, or whether the 'approve' step is manual in Blotato's UI
Is the 41.9M/30-day claim attributable to this workflow or to Sabrina Ramonoff's existing audience?
Is the guide an email-capture funnel (claudecodeclub.ai)?

gap.what: New tool: Blotato (paid multi-platform poster) and a concrete 'one link -> per-platform captions -> approve -> post' loop. Liked set had Postiz (open-source scheduler) but not this specific workflow.
